scope: The 50 unique Linear tickets audited in screen-reader.spec.ts before this consolidation.
policy: Every ticket must resolve to at least one relevant test. Partial mappings are not proof of the original remedy. Removing Guidepup coverage requires replacement browser evidence and explicit AT limitations.

browserRun.scope: Only the browser cases replacing the audited candidates. No full suite or Guidepup execution.
browserRun.command: PORT=3001 MONGODB_URL=<isolated test database> pnpm test:e2e a11y --grep 'default login logo|expose required state without naming|identify the .* row on its drag control|describe pickup movement drop|drop a keyboard-dragged|active sort direction on relationship table|selected folder as the current|visit every theme option|current locale and popup state|name version table per-page|live-preview zoom name, expansion|selected Add Blocks option by name|disabled Paste or Replace|Welcome and the signed-in account|navigate LLM instructions tabs|name LLM instructions editors' --workers=1

verification.screenReaderRun: Not run on this laptop; do not infer AT success from browser assertions.

tests: WCAG.e2e.spec.ts :: should preserve dashboard focus and expose widget content and independent actions while editing
earlierMigrations.manual: User confirmed error announcement on the focused card and keyboard transition to drag handle in Playwright WebKit with VoiceOver.

tests: WCAG.e2e.spec.ts :: should give the Copy to locale dialog a concise accessible name without repeating its contents
earlierMigrations.manual: NVDA opening announcement remains unverified; concise DOM name/description does not prove absence of duplicate speech.

outstanding: PYLD-3671 and PYLD-3678: current assertions permit a native label stop, unlike the original single-stop requirement. Native WebKit baseline also repeats labels. These remain partial coverage.
PYLD-3580: six-second dismissal tests do not establish persistence while the screen-reader cursor is on the toast.
PYLD-3613: submit-time validation tests do not establish the original error/readout after editing and clearing the password.
Reported NVDA/Chrome failures require that platform's evidence; this branch's default Windows Guidepup project uses Firefox.
NVDA browse-mode tests and screen-reader cursor containment must retain AT evidence.
Guidepup queue hazards removed from retained direction/version/widget captures; remote AT verification is still required.
